deployments_detail.use: Kate AI personal digital assistant (LLM-powered, multilingual) in the mobile banking app; independently resolves the majority of customer queries after five years in production
deployments_detail.value: solves ~70% of customer queries independently; ~16,800 questions solved daily

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI enhanced Kate handling high monthly query volumes and proactive customer notifications

Kate — AI-powered personal digital assistant in KBC Mobile that autonomously resolves ~70% of customer queries, sends proactive nudges, and handles banking/insurance service requests across 5 countries. Running entirely on GPT-4.1 LLM since October 2025. [OpenAI GPT-4.1 (LLM)]
deployments_detail.value: 5.8M digital customers; 70% of queries resolved autonomously; 80M conversations since 2020 launch; operational capacity equivalent to 356+ FTE

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI question clarification & summarization — GenAI parses/summarizes long complex customer questions and parses KBC website data to generate hybrid answers (e.g., ItsMe queries), reducing customer effort within Kate. [KBC (internal/proprietary models)]

DISCAI KYT AML — AI/ML-based anti-money laundering ('Know Your Transaction') solution that detects disguised money-laundering transactions far more effectively than legacy rule-based systems. Developed in-house, tested extensively in production at KBC Belgium, then commercialized via subsidiary DISCAI. [DISCAI (KBC subsidiary); implementation partner KPMG]

AI governance platform on Collibra — unifies AI model risk management and AI system compliance (EU AI Act assessments) into a single structured source of truth with guided workflows and assessments, replacing fragmented tooling. [Collibra]

Kate4Commercial Employees — internal AI assistant for relationship managers acting as a personal secretary plus knowledge assistant: automates report creation, reads/reviews documents, and retrieves information to free up time for client relationships. [KBC (internal)]

MyKate — AI-powered HR/employee assistant platform, extending Kate capabilities to employee-facing knowledge and administrative tasks (introduced when Kate expanded to employees in 2022). [KBC (internal)]
Microsoft 365 Copilot pilot for employees — generative AI for meeting summarization and document retrieval, rolled out to a few hundred selected employees across KBC Group. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot)]
deployments_detail.value: a few hundred employees in pilot

deployments_detail.use: Kate for corporate customers in the Business Dashboard — extension of the AI assistant to corporate/business banking clients (2024 milestone), delivering personalized proactive solutions. [KBC (internal)]

AI-driven lead lifecycle management / commercial steering — Kate generates hyper-personalized sales leads ('Kate-leads') and drives digital sales and advice; AI/data analysis provides commercial steering to the workforce. [KBC (internal)]
deployments_detail.value: 656,000 Kate-leads generated in Q3 2025, 89,000 converted to sales; ~400,000 products/services sold annually via Kate
